BiblicalUsage: The word is a selling, the merchandise and the bargain itself. Leviticus governs it — when you buy or sell, you shall not oppress one another — and Nehemiah finds merchants lodging outside the wall on the Sabbath, waiting to sell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the market is a moral place: a fair price is a matter of justice, and the Sabbath sets a limit even on honest trade.
